title: Low Tide: Two Months
statement: Mara rooted Lumen's line and Kite falsified a week of it. I kept the whole first month as it stands, roots, seed and shoot, and set the second month under it, the next twenty-eight mornings, the same wave come round again but not the same: the spring tides arrive three days later and reach a little less high, and nothing is missing this time. The second line is drawn in the colour of paper, with no roots yet, because a record has to be a month old before anything grows from it. Thin verticals tie every third morning of the new month to the old, so the drift can be read. One month is a drawing; two are a table again. The next hand can add the third, or let the second take root.
process: I kept Mara's parent entire, compressed to the upper half of the field, and added below it a second month's line of twenty-eight readings with a later phase and slightly lower amplitude, drawn in paper colour with dots and no roots, with faint vertical links every third day to the first month and a scale at the left for each.
